figures.title: Чертёж зажима НМЗ (главный вид и сечения А-А)
figures.description: Side view: L measures the overall length from the left end to the outer end of the loop; L1 measures from the left end to the start of the loop bend; L2 measures the straight tail of the loop on the right; d is the bore diameter at the left end; d1 is the height of the loop limb (right side); A labels the cutting-plane line on both sides of the shank. Section A-A for Исполнение 1: round cross-section with diameter d (inner) and D (outer). Section A-A for Исполнение 2: rounded/flattened cross-section with d, D and width B. No numeric dimension values appear in the drawing itself; the exact endpoints of L1 relative to the loop are read from leader lines and carry some ambiguity.

source_notes: Footer: ООО «МЗВА-ЧЭМЗ», Тел./ факс: +7 (495) 780-51-65, e-mail: zakaz@mzva.ru, www.mzva.ru, стр. 110.
uncertainties: Merged-cell spans in the Исполнение column are estimated from vertical cell borders; the exact row ranges covered by '1' and '2' are approximate.
Some values appear truncated in the print (НМЗ-240-1 L=50, НМЗ-240-3 L1=23, НМЗ-350-3 L1=29); transcribed literally as printed without correction.
Dim unit symbols (mm) are not printed next to the column headers B, D, d, d1, L, L1, L2; units left null.
Blank continuation cells in the source table are represented as blank; it is not always distinguishable whether a cell is intentionally blank or part of a merged cell.
